rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and operated only on that user’s account. It retrieved the user’s orders, identified the two pending t-shirt items, and sought explicit confirmation specifying the exact changes and the payment method for any price difference before making any modifications. After receiving confirmation, it executed the changes via the proper tool, updating each t-shirt to purple, size S, v-neck, polyester. The agent then accurately reported the updated order details and the small price differences, which align with the tool outputs. No unsupported claims or policy violations are evident. The initial product-count response was based on a product details lookup and does not conflict with tool data. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
